title: Configure the legend and inspect data

blocks.content:
The legend helps readers identify data series in your panel. The panel inspector lets you examine raw data when something doesn't look right.

To configure the legend, complete the following steps:

1. In the display options sidebar, scroll to the **Legend** section.
2. Set **Mode** to **Table** to display the legend as a table with value columns.
3. Under **Values**, select **Min**, **Max**, and **Mean** to show calculated values next to each series name.
4. Set **Placement** to **Bottom** to position the legend below the visualization.

To inspect the panel data, complete the following steps:

1. Click the panel title to open the panel menu.
2. Select **Inspect** > **Data**.
3. The panel inspector opens showing the raw data returned by your query. You can download this data as CSV.
4. Click the **Stats** tab to see query performance: how long the query took and how many rows it returned.
5. Close the inspector and click **Save dashboard** to save your configuration.
